profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer / Data Architect
profile.summary: Results-driven and highly analytical Lead Software Architect with extensive experience in designing, installing, testing, and maintaining innovative software and application systems. Demonstrated success in leading software projects, implementing architecture, event systems, and APIs using RabbitMQ, Redis, and gRPC. Exceptional ability to identify and resolve complex issues, meet project deadlines, and build time-saving solutions. Strong background in mentoring and training teams, fostering professional relationships, and driving continuous improvement.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer / Data Architect
positions.description:
Assist in the creation of a high-performance computing (HPC) simulation. Resolve major conflicts caused by many processes attempting to access same resources concurrently by creating async gRPC lock API. Facilitate development processes by designing and deploying event system along with conducting trainings and code reviews.

• Independently designed and deployed new architecture through utilization of RabbitMQ as well as crafted design documents and proof-of-concept demo, while writing overall clean code.
• Enabled conversion of entire existing codebase from synchronous to asynchronous within three days along with executing mentoring sessions to upskills other engineers in programming.
• Craft design documents and present research to project management team for an ongoing project of designing new distributed event-based state management system using gRPC with state fast-forward/rewind capabilities.
• Draft unit testing documentation regarding best practices and lead a team in implementation of new practices, preparing them to mentor other teams.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Salt Lake City, Utah, United States
positions.description:
Established close collaboration with customers to identify/resolve bugs and create patches. Leveraged strong expertise in utilizing JIRA to track issues. Participated in refactoring meetings and constantly presented innovative ideas to team. Delivered training sessions to fellow engineers and customers with aim to boost professional development. Rendered significant efforts in redesigning tool used to interact with data pulled from AWS S3.

• Rewrote utility from scratch to process JSON data according to customer-specified configuration rules, while maintaining backwards compatibility.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer / Systems Architect / Database Administrator
positions.description:
Resolved scaling issues by designing new architecture developed using docker. Supervised and provided continual aid to teams in various aspects, including project design and management. Performed various responsibilities such as maintaining and developing EHR cloud software. Processed large-scale data sets of FDA drugs by building application programming interface (APIs).

• Delivered impeccable IT support to a wide range of clients and ensured complete client satisfaction.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Built ORM for Airtable to extract away difficulty of interacting with Airtable APIs for student tracking.
